thread:
sophie (support): FYI — after this morning's rate-limit adjustment we started getting a cluster of reports: repeated 429s + client retry loops that push latency up. We rolled the new limits to ~15% of traffic at 08:00 PT as a staged push. Customers affected: acme-corp, beta-inc, a handful of PLG trial orgs.

sophie (support): Symptoms: rapid 429 spikes (x9 vs baseline), client retries saturating ingress, some customers seeing 10-30s tail latency. Example response headers from affected request:

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 15:12:07 GMT
Content-Type: application/json
X-RateLimit-Policy: rl-v2-2026
X-RateLimit-Limit: 60/min
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
Retry-After: 2
```

sophie (support): Repro curl (from a repro script that reproduces retry spiral):
```
for i in {1..120}; do curl -s -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"x"}' & done
```

aj (eng-platform): Can you paste the policy id (exact)? also need a few trace ids and a sample request-id when it happened so we can find the token-bucket metrics. If possible, please pause the gradual push; we can flip it back to 0% while we diagnose.

sophie (support): Policy id is rl-v2-2026. Two trace ids from acme request logs: trace-9001, trace-9044. Request-IDs: rq_7f82, rq_7f85. We'll pause if you confirm the pause command.

kevin (eng-sre): Immediate mitigations to consider: 1) pause the rollout to stop new traffic hitting rl-v2-2026 2) temporarily raise burst allowance for the "legacy" customer tier to absorb retry storms 3) ensure Retry-After is respected and returned consistently. I can push 2) now if you want.

deploy-bot: staged-rollout status: rl-v2-2026 -> 15% traffic applied at 1995432080 (08:00 PT).

aj (eng-platform): To pause rollout from control plane: run (admin):
```
redwoodctl rollout set --policy rl-v2-2026 --pct 0 --reason "emergency pause - support escalations"
```
I'll standing by to run this if an owner confirms. Also opening a revert PR to restore previous limits (will tag kevin).

maria (customer-success): I can notify the top affected customers. ETA 25min email with mitigations + we should include expected ETA for fix. Please confirm if we want to advise "workaround: slow down client retry backoff to 10s" or if we should provide a server-side fix first.

kevin (eng-sre): I'm going to bump legacy-tier burst from 50 -> 250 for 1 hour and add a temporary fallback that maps requests from orgs in the PLG bucket to the old token-bucket algorithm. Doing that now. Will monitor the 429 rate and CPU on gateway.

kevin (eng-sre): pushed fallback routing change at 1995432260. If you still see 429s after 2-3 minutes, paste request-IDs here.

sophie (support): Confirming we still see reduced but persistent 429s for a few trial orgs; major customers look better. Repro trace trace-9044 shows Retry-After cycles still being honored but clients retry too aggressively.

aj (eng-platform): PR opened to revert limit delta -> link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/platform/merge/1234 (revert rl-v2-2026). If kevin's fallback is stable we'll still push the revert to be safe.

maria (customer-success): Sending outbound note now to acme-corp & beta-inc. Adding temporary mitigations and asking for logs if they still see events after 10m.

kevin (eng-sre): Monitoring dashboard: 429s down from x9 -> x2 for affected cohort after bump/fallback. Gateway CPU up ~6%. Keeping patch for 1 hour then reevaluate.

sophie (support): I'm filing an incident: INC-2026-78 and adding the traces + affected org list. Assigning to eng-platform (aj) and eng-sre (kevin).

account-bot: Incident INC-2026-78 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-78 (assigned: aj, kevin, sophie)

aj (eng-platform): thumbs up. I'll coordinate the rollback PR and also add a small traffic-smoothing filter so short bursts from retry loops are shaped for 30s.

kevin (eng-sre): If rollback PR merges, we should watch for any regression when we re-enable staged push. Plan: revert -> validate 1h -> reattempt a more gradual roll with per-org ramping.

sophie (support): Thanks all. I'll keep thread updated with additional request-IDs and customer replies. :thumbsup:
